<function name="GetNW2String" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Retrieves a networked string value at specified index on the entity that is set by <page>Entity:SetNW2String</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="string">The key that is associated with the value</arg>
		<arg name="fallback" type="any" default="">The value to return if we failed to retrieve the value. (If it isn't set)</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="any">The value associated with the key</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
